article.title: A pragmatic randomized controlled trial of self-directed online writing interventions for posttraumatic stress symptoms in a real-world digital setting.
article.authors: Li M, Bao J, Ni T
article.abstract: An RCT compared expressive writing and guided narrative technique-writing.PTSD was significantly reduced in both self-help writing groups.We expanded the intervention’s access via a major social media platform.
